body: BoogieWitDaHoodie continues to prove the lasting impact of his 2016 project “Artist” as he celebrates the album’s 10-year anniversary with two sold-out shows in Boston. A decade later, the music, the memories, and the connection with his fans remain just as strong. What started as a defining chapter in his career has grown into a project that continues to resonate with listeners years later.
